power.greenlantern.lasso_capture.desc: The Lasso of Truth closes around the first creature it meets. Bound, it can't run away or fight for a few seconds.
power.greenlantern.lasso_pull.desc: The lasso yanks a creature to your feet. Thrown at a wall, it pulls you there.
power.greenlantern.lasso_spin.desc: With a creature caught, swing it through the air (it bowls everything over) and hurl it where you look. With nothing caught, the lasso whirls around you like a golden blade.
power.greenlantern.bracelet_guard.desc: Cross the Bracelets of Submission: blows from the front are blocked and arrows, fireballs and tridents fly back at the shooter. Use again to lower them.
power.greenlantern.bracelet_shockwave.de: The bracelets clash: a wave of force throws everything around and shatters glass. Stronger after blocking hits.
power.greenlantern.sword_and_shield.desc: The Amazon sword in your hand and the shield on your arm. Use again to put them away.
power.greenlantern.shield_throw.desc: The shield flies spinning, ricochets from enemy to enemy and comes back to your arm.
power.greenlantern.invisible_jet.desc: The Invisible Jet lands next to you and you climb aboard. Use again to send it away.

guide.greenlantern.wonder_woman.title: Wonder Woman
guide.greenlantern.wonder_woman:
From the island of Themyscira comes §cWonder Woman§r, princess of the Amazons.

§6The tiara§r
Craft the §6Tiara of Themyscira§r (gold, red dye, leads and a diamond). Right-click or press §eG§r to put on the armor: the red bodice with the golden eagle, the blue skirt with white stars, the red boots, the silver Bracelets of Submission and the tiara. One hero at a time: putting on a suit takes the others off.

§6The Amazon princess§r
In the armor you are stronger, tougher, quicker and steadier (you are barely knocked back), reach farther, jump higher and take no fall damage. She is mighty, but not as mighty as Superman.

§6Flight§r
§eDouble-tap jump§r to take off. Her flight is free, but weaker than the Green Lantern's: it speeds up more slowly and has a lower top speed, never breaking the sound barrier. It leaves a gold and red trail.

§6Divine power§r
The powers use divine power (the golden bar). It comes back on its own while you wear the armor, and every sword blow gives a little back too.
guide.greenlantern.wonder_woman_powers:
In the armor, hold §eR§r for the power menu (tap R for the next one) and press §eV§r (or right-click with the tiara) to use it.

§6Lasso of Truth§r
§eCapture§r: the golden lasso closes around the creature; bound, it can't run or fight. §ePull§r: yanks the creature to you or, thrown at a wall, pulls you there. §eSpin§r: with a creature caught, swing it over your head, battering everything, and hurl it where you look; with nothing caught, the lasso whirls around you and sweeps the creatures away.

§6Bracelets of Submission§r
§eGuard§r: cross the bracelets for a few seconds. Blows from the front are blocked and projectiles fly back at the shooter. Even without guarding, an arrow from the front sometimes bounces off a bracelet. §eShockwave§r: the bracelets clash and throw everything around, shattering glass and ice. Every blocked blow makes the next wave bigger.

§6Amazon Sword and Shield§r
The sword cuts through the enemies around the target. The shield blocks like any shield and never breaks. §eShield Throw§r (or §eSneak + right-click§r with the shield): it flies spinning, ricochets off up to 3 enemies and comes back to your arm, like Aquaman's trident. The sword and shield only exist in her hands.

§6Invisible Jet§r
The jet lands next to you and you climb aboard. It flies where you look: §eW§r throttles up, §eS§r slows down to a hover, §eA D§r slide sideways and §ejump§r climbs. Hold §eCtrl§r for the afterburner. §eLeft-click§r cloaks the jet: you turn invisible and monsters lose sight of you. The canopy takes most of the damage. §eSneak§r gets out. Left parked alone for 3 minutes, it flies away.
guide.greenlantern.controls_wonder_woman:
§eRight-click§r (tiara): put on the armor or use the power.
§eG§r: put on / take off the armor.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: speed up. §eCtrl§r: speed up faster.
§eR§r (hold / tap): power menu / next power.
§eV§r: uses the selected power.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (tiara in hand): switch power.
§eSneak + right-click§r (shield): throw the shield.
§eIn the jet§r: §eW S A D§r and §ejump§r fly, §eCtrl§r afterburner, §eleft-click§r cloak, §eSneak§r get out.
